newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso reverses firmness on dlr buyback.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso reverses firmness on dlr buyback.

text.p: Mexico peso contracts reversed their initial strength to stand slightly softer at active mid-morning trade on Wednesday after dealers decided to purchase dollars.
"It looks like dealers took advantage of price levels to pick up some long dollar positions," a trader said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart were trading 0.4 and 0.2 of a centavo weaker, respectively, at 7.8400/7.8450 and 7.8380/7.8420 per dollar.
Same-day peso contracts had meanwhile closed trade for the day 1.0 centavo firmer at 7.8370/7.8410 per dollar.
